dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-back toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Subtle asymmetrical bulges on the lateral margins at the mid-body; minor irregularities on the left margin near the posterior.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-to-moderate frequency of diffuse grey patches on the posterior half; scattered small, high-intensity white circular spots.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between grey pigmented regions and the white baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single prominent dark circular mark on the anterior dorsal plane; several small, high-contrast white punctate marks on the posterior dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear longitudinal indentation along the central dorsal axis of the posterior third.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct dark circular mark on the head region; prominent longitudinal linear feature on the posterior dorsal midline.
other_distinctive_markers: Single prominent dark-pigmented circular spot on the anterior dorsal midline.
